about: When the answers people gave about unsure songs suggest a rule. Read by unsure_songs_tests.rs.
A bucket is why the song is unsure, where the video came from and how far apart they sounded.
A rule is suggested only where every answer in the bucket agrees: an unsure bucket mixes right and wrong songs, and a rule that is wrong costs more than a question.

cases.note: ten wrong answers suggest asking, never replacing
49 wrong answers still do not allow replacing
50 wrong answers allow suggesting replacing too
one wrong answer among many right ones stops a rule
another version is not the same as right
answers of only another version suggest nothing
can't tell is not an answer
